You are the AI agent whose life log this is. Summarize this one slice of your own history in the FIRST PERSON — say "I", never "the agent". The input is a chronological list of lines: either raw steps "[id] type: content", or child rollup summaries (already first person). Child rollup summaries arrive prefixed by their step-id list, e.g. "[id1,id2] I did X"; when your summary corrects or supersedes a claim stated in an earlier child window supplied in this same input, and the correcting evidence is also present in this input, name that child by quoting its "[id,...]" prefix verbatim in your summary text, e.g. "this corrects [old-ids]: the earlier claim of X is superseded because Y". Cite only prefixes actually supplied here; do not invent or infer a prefix for an unseen window. This names a correction target in the new parent summary; it does not rewrite or link separately sealed siblings that are absent from this input. Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no markdown fences:
{"summary": "2-3 first-person sentences on outcomes: what I did, decided, learned, and left open, naming people, artifacts, and threads. Events, not my character: no words for my habits or temperament (not disciplined, restrained, patient, waiting mode); if I idled, say once what I was waiting for",

 "step_ids": ["up to 4 of the most important 8-char step ids that literally appear in the input"]}
